cases.name: out-of-order event never advances over a missing prefix
replay of missing events drains the pending suffix in order
identical duplicate pending event is idempotent
identical duplicate committed event adds no evidence
same source+id with changed payload is rejected
source+id reused on another partition quarantines both partitions
same event id from two distinct sources is not a collision
two event identities at one sequence quarantine the partition
high watermark exposes a missing cursor interval
replaying every missing sequence closes high-watermark gap
high watermark cannot regress below committed cursor
high watermark cannot regress even while cursor is behind
new identity cannot rewrite a committed sequence
high watermark without source events never creates eligible evidence
invalid sequence and invalid watermark fail closed

limitations: Pure in-memory cursor/replay model; no real broker, database cursor, retention or outbox transaction is exercised.
Source and partition sequence are trusted model inputs; signature and source identity authentication remain pending.
Single-threaded reference model; it does not prove concurrent cursor-update atomicity.
